title: Loop document v0.9 (CE-R5.1)
description: The complete intended CONTROL state for the next loop, rendered by the Rust engine (crates/engines_core/src/loop_doc.rs). v0.9 (ADR 0054) writes every param in its native unit under a unit-suffixed key — `cutoff_hz`, `attack_s`, `level_db` (-Infinity = silent), `voices_detune_cents`, `shift_st`, `predelay_ms` — and a route's depth in its dest's unit (`depth_oct`, `depth_db`, …); the unitless levers stay 0..1. `global.reverb_mix` is gone (a doc without buses plays dry). `engines-migrate` converts a v0.8 doc. v0.8 (ADR 0010) added top-level `safe_bounds` (Tier-2 per-param controllable ranges; canonical defaults in `x-safe-bounds-defaults`) and per-modulator `orrery_role`; ADR 0025 adds `max_change`/`max_drift`; ADR 0026 adds the `midi` instrument type (external-MIDI translator: `routing`, `velocity_default`, per-voice `velocity`); ADR 0028 adds per-voice sub-step onset `t`, top-level `sequence_pools`, and the modulator `phrase` arm (steps ⊕ generator ⊕ phrase); ADR 0029 adds the optional top-level `song` (a sequence of matrix-configuration blocks). ADR 0033 adds the piece's own control settings — top-level `optimize`, `movement` (the Orrery) and `constraints` (Tier-3 bands) — so a piece is self-contained; CLI flags / an objectives doc override them. Carried over from v0.7: `modulators`/`matrix`/per-step `voicing` are id-keyed objects; `steps`/`pitch_walk.pool` stay arrays; a matrix `dest` is a full JSONPath. Annotated source: doc/loop_contract_v0.9.json5. Note offsets are semitones from harmony.root at octave 4. MIDI `velocity`/`velocity_default` are native 0..127. `x-silence: true` marks the numbers that may be -Infinity (the gains, a band's min).

loop_id.description: monotonic; also the root RNG seed (prob rolls, noise) — deterministic per id

meta.description: free-form provenance/telemetry; not interpreted by the engine

master_steps.description: loop length in steps; loop seconds = master_steps * 60/bpm

swing.description: delay every ODD on-grid step by swing·step/3 (1 = the offbeat sits on the 2/3 triplet point). Sub-step (fractional t) onsets are authored micro-timing and never swing (ADR 0028)

timing_jitter_ms.description: humanize: every note onset shifts by a deterministic seeded offset in ±this many ms (adds to the modulator's humanize_ms; a gated note's off rides its onset) (ADR 0028)

root.description: note name; e.g. C, F#, Bb

mode.description: scale label for scale-aware features (e.g. dorian); does not constrain chord offsets

master_gain_db.description: the master out's gain in dB (−60..+6, -Infinity silent; no limiter follows — ADR 0021)

buses.description: Send-bus / effects framework. Instruments route a `sends_db` level into a bus; the bus runs a fundsp-graph effects chain and returns its wet signal to the master at `return_gain_db`. Param JSONPaths (e.g. buses.<bus>.effects.<fx>.params.room) are controller-steerable.

sequence_pools.description: Predefined melodic phrases (ADR 0028), id-keyed — the doc-local sequence pool. A note modulator plays them via its `phrase` arm; `lib:<name>` pool refs resolve to the built-in library instead (same shape — entries copy-paste between the two). Ids starting with lib: are reserved.

safe_bounds.description: Tier-2 SAFE BOUNDS (ADR 0010): JSONPath -> {min,max} in NATIVE units — the hard controllable range the controller must never exceed. Overrides the canonical per-param defaults (see x-safe-bounds-defaults); absent params fall back to those. Example key: global.master_gain_db -> min −8, max 0. A route depth's key is its depth key (matrix.<id>.depth_oct).

max_change.description: PER-LOOP step cap |δ| in normalized 0..1 (ADR 0025). Authored default; the runtime `--max-change` overrides it, else the controller default 0.05.

max_drift.description: CUMULATIVE drift cap (ADR 0025): the half-width in normalized 0..1 that drift may move a param from its authored value over the whole session (max_change bounds one loop; max_drift bounds the total). Default 0.15. A param-specific `constraints` band or objectives `override` takes precedence over this; the Tier-2 safe range is still the hard cap.

optimize.description: The piece's timbre axis (ADR 0033; CE-R8.1): `hold` freezes the authored values (free modulators still breathe), `drift` is the bounded reflecting walk (ADR 0032), `live_edit` = no drift while hand-editing. Absent with `movement`/`constraints` also absent ⇒ the session's own default (drift). CLI `--optimize` and an `--objectives` file override it.

movement.description: The piece's musical-movement axis (ADR 0033): the Orrery on/off + its config — same shape as the objectives doc's `movement`. CLI `--orrery` switches it on; an `--objectives` file replaces it. Live edits to it apply at the next loop with the Orrery's state kept.

constraints.description: The piece's Tier-3 runtime constraint bands (ADR 0033), JSONPath -> {min,max} in NATIVE units: a param outside its band is driven back at <= max_change, and drift reflects off the band edges (ADR 0032). Freeze a param with min == max. Tighter than safe_bounds (the Tier-2 hard cap).

song.description: Song form (ADR 0029): a 'loop of loops'. An ordered `sequence` of blocks, each a MATRIX configuration (the top-level `matrix` with a named layer from `matrices` merged over it by route id — RFC 7386: a field overrides, null removes, a full entry adds) lasting `loops` inner loops. The controller (drift + the Orrery) resets at each block start; the song ends after the last block + `tail_loops`. Blocks change the matrix and, through an optional `control`, the session control (ADR 0055: the Orrery off or retuned, hold or drift, per-param drift overrides); instruments, modulators, harmony, transport and globals are fixed for the whole song.

matrices.description: named matrix layers: layer name → { route id → matrix-entry patch | null }

transition_s.description: seam glide seconds (params ease back to the new block's authored values; routes fade in/out; un-routed notes release). 0 = hard cut. Must not exceed the shortest block.

tail_loops.description: loops after the last block with every note route dropped, so releases + reverb ring out before the song ends

type.description: Synth type (ADR 0009). subtractive (default, absent ⇒ subtractive): one oscillator + shared filter/ADSR. dual: two oscillators (Hydrasynth-style), each to the mixer at its own level; osc B can phase-modulate osc A (DX-style PM + feedback). modal: parallel decaying-resonator bank for struck objects (marimba/vibraphone/tuning-fork/resonators), intrinsic decay. midi (ADR 0026): an external-MIDI translator — produces NO audio; its note events become Note-On/Off and its effective (post-modulation) params become CC, per its required `routing`. binaural (ADR 0047): a binaural-beat drone — two subtractive voices, the left hard LEFT at root − spread_hz/2 and the right hard RIGHT at root + spread_hz/2 (root = `root_hz` when set, else the note), sharing every subtractive param; its dry output bypasses the master `stereo_width` (headphones). Never dithered (it changes per-voice state shape; midi params additionally lack a −δ counterfactual).

pitched.description: On a filtered_noise instrument, true turns on the note's band (ADR 0046): the band_lo..band_hi noise goes on through a band-pass at each voice's note, falling 24 dB/oct either side, with `resonance` raising the note toward a whistle. Leave it out (or false) for plain band noise.

dither_disable.description: Controller opt-out: when true, the controller never dithers this instrument (neither numeric params nor categorical enabled/wave). Pin a constant voice (e.g. a fixed bass drone). Matrix modulation still applies.

polyphony.description: simultaneous voices; 0 never sounds (engines-check warns) — and an instrument with no `note_engine` at all has 0

glide_ms.description: portamento time on a same-id pitch change

sends_db.description: Send levels in dB into named buses, keyed by bus id (−60..+6; -Infinity = no send). Empty = dry only.

velocity_default.description: MIDI velocity for voices that don't author their own `velocity` (ADR 0026; type "midi" only). Native MIDI units (ADR 0005 seam rule).

out_channel.description: Multichannel stem routing (ADR 0027): first channel of the STEREO PAIR on the output device this instrument's dry signal goes to instead of the main 1/2 pair — 1-based and ODD (3 ⇒ channels 3/4), so a DAW taking the device (e.g. BlackHole 16ch) can mix each instrument on its own track. 1/2 always carries the rest of the mix (un-routed instruments + bus/reverb returns); sends still feed buses (the wet stays on 1/2). Folds back into 1/2 if the opened device has too few channels. Observation-only: renders, stems and the internal mix are unaffected. Audio instruments only (not type "midi").

params.description: On a midi translator, params are free-form named value-holders (0..1) — CC sources under `routing.cc` and matrix-modulation destinations; they never reach a synth.

midiRouting.description: Where a type "midi" instrument's output goes (ADR 0026). The MUSICAL mapping lives here; binding to an OS port/device is a shell concern (CLI flag) so the core stays I/O-free.

channel.description: human MIDI channel 1..16 (wire messages use channel−1). Two midi instruments sharing a channel is linted: overlapping note numbers can cut each other off.

cc.description: param name → CC number. Each mapped param's EFFECTIVE value (base + all matrix modulation, incl. free-running LFOs) is quantized to 7 bits and emitted on change (initial full sync burst on session start). Mapped params must exist in `params` (validated).

type.description: Absent ⇒ an internal effects bus. "external_return" (ADR 0026 phase D, at most one per doc): a DAW-audio-return — session/shell config only (no effects, no audio in the core render). The shell captures a loopback input (--return-device) and monitor-mixes it into the live output at return_gain_db.

return_gain_db.description: wet return level into the master mix in dB (−60..+6; -Infinity, the default, is silent; external_return: the live monitor-mix gain)

latency_ms.description: external_return only: the MIDI→DAW→loopback round trip. Parsed but inert since ADR 0031 (it aligned the return for the removed learner's scoring)

effects.description: ordered (sorted-id) effect chain (must be absent/empty on an external_return bus — the DAW owns its processing)

params.description: effect knobs (all 0..1 except `predelay_ms`). reverb: room, damping, shimmer (octave-up feedback), width (build-time-fixed), predelay_ms (0..100 ms).

Base values, each in its native unit under a unit-suffixed key (schema v0.9, ADR 0054): Hz, s, dB (-Infinity = silent), cents, semitones, a ratio; the unitless ones (`resonance`, `sustain`, the mixes, the modal levers, `fm_index`, `fm_feedback`) stay 0..1. Amp envelope is note-relative; the instrument literally named `event` uses a bell (exp `decay_s`) envelope instead of full ADSR. Type-specific params (dual/modal, ADR 0009; binaural, ADR 0047) live here alongside the base ones.

wave.description: oscillator; unknown names fall back to sine

level_db.description: the voice's level in dB (−60..+6; -Infinity = silent). Default −6.02 dB

cutoff_hz.description: low-pass corner in Hz (80..8000, log; capped at Nyquist). A note whose fundamental is above it is filtered to near-silence. Default 2009.51

resonance.description: filter Q, 0..1 → ~0.707..6. On a `pitched: true` filtered_noise instrument: the peak at the note, 0 (none) .. 1 (+24 dB, narrow — a near-whistle), at the same loudness

drive_db.description: soft-clip pre-gain in dB (0..+20 = ×1..×10; 0 bypasses the clipper)

decay_s.description: ADSR decay in seconds (0..4); for the legacy `event` bell, its ring length

sustain.description: ADSR hold LEVEL (the audible steady state). sustain 0 + short decay = pluck.

band_lo_hz.description: filtered_noise bandpass low edge in Hz (20..4000, log; with `pitched: true`, the note's band sits inside this one, so open it below a low note to give the note noise)

band_hi_hz.description: filtered_noise bandpass high edge in Hz (20..4000, log)

voices_detune_cents.description: unison detune in cents: the instrument's sounding voices spread evenly across ±this (0..100)

shift_st.description: octave-pedal interval in semitones (−24..+24); the crossfade target for shift_mix

shift_mix.description: dry↔shifted crossfade; needs a nonzero `shift_st` to be audible

osc_a_level_db.description: dual: osc A level into the mixer in dB (−60..+6; -Infinity = off). Default −1.94 dB

osc_b_level_db.description: dual: osc B level into the mixer in dB (independent of whether B modulates A; -Infinity = off, the default)

osc_b_ratio.description: dual: osc B frequency ratio to the note (NATIVE units; integer ⇒ harmonic, fractional ⇒ inharmonic)

osc_b_detune_cents.description: dual: osc B detune in cents, upward (0..50)

fm_index.description: dual: osc-B→osc-A phase-modulation depth, 0..1 → 0..8 rad. 0 ⇒ pure dual-osc

fm_feedback.description: dual: operator self-feedback on osc B (DX-style)

material.description: modal (ADR 0009): struck-object preset (partial ratios + decay character)

num_modes.description: modal: number of resonator modes (capped to the preset's available partials)

t60_s.description: modal, t60_mode 'fixed' (the default): the fundamental's ring time in seconds (0.05..8, log). Default 0.63

ring_ratio.description: modal, t60_mode 'note': the ring as a ratio of the driving note's length (0.5..2, log): 1 ⇒ T60 ≈ the note, <1 staccato, >1 blooms past it

t60_mode.description: modal: ring-length source — 'fixed' (default) rings for `t60_s`; 'note' couples the ring to the driving note's own duration (its source step) through `ring_ratio`, so step_duration controls how long each strike sounds

brightness.description: modal: high-mode rolloff (lower ⇒ darker, fewer audible partials)

strike_pos.description: modal: strike position (bar mode-shape weighting, sin(π·k·pos))

stretch.description: modal: inharmonicity (pushes higher partials progressively sharper)

root_hz.description: binaural (ADR 0047): the pair's root frequency in REAL Hz (fractions allowed, e.g. 109.5). Set ⇒ the routed note only gates the voice (its pitch is ignored; `voices_detune_cents` still spreads unison voices around it). Absent ⇒ the root is the note's pitch, so it follows the key and the Orrery. Matrix-modulatable (a route's depth is a fraction of the 20..1000 range), never drifted.

spread_hz.description: binaural (ADR 0047): the L/R spread in REAL Hz — the beat rate. Left = root − spread_hz/2, right = root + spread_hz/2 (110 / 2 ⇒ 109 | 111). Bands: delta < 4, theta 4–8, alpha 8–13, beta 13–30, gamma ≥ 30. Matrix-modulatable (a route's depth is a fraction of the 0..40 range), never drifted.

output.description: control = a 0..1 curve summed into a param; note = discrete note events. lfo is always control.

orrery_disable.description: Orrery mode opt-out: when true, the generative harmony layer never rewrites this note modulator's notes/voices — mark a constant "underdrone". Still read as fixed-pitch harmonic context (v0.8). Ignored outside Orrery mode.

orrery_role.description: Orrery role binding (v0.8, ADR 0010): bind this note modulator to a generative role instead of by id. context = read-only harmonic input. Parsed in Phase 0; consumed in Phase 4.

orrery_note_min.description: the lowest note the Orrery may write into this modulator: a semitone offset from the harmony root (like a voicing offset). An Orrery move that would cross it is skipped; a single note still outside folds back by octaves (ADR 0042). Takes precedence over a pool entry's written line: phrases re-fit inside it (fit arp is bounded by it instead of its written extremes; with one bound set the other side is open). Ignored outside Orrery mode.

orrery_note_max.description: the highest note the Orrery may write into this modulator (semitone offset from the harmony root); see orrery_note_min (ADR 0042).

sync.description: loop = restart each bar; free = carry phase across loops (drifts → polyrhythm)

step_duration.description: step length as a fraction of the master loop, e.g. "1/16" (n, d > 0 — "1/0" / "0/8" are rejected); default 1/length

humanize_ms.description: per-modulator humanize added to transport.timing_jitter_ms: seeded deterministic ±ms onset jitter (ADR 0028)

interp.description: control step_seq: linear interpolation between points (else stepped/held)

entry_value.description: control step_seq: value before the first step (seam continuity)

then.description: the phrase arm (ADR 0028) is a step_seq NOTE source with an explicit step_duration, exclusive with steps/generator/pitch_walk — mirrors LoopDoc::validate()

value.description: control step_seq: the value at this step

voicing.description: note step_seq: id-keyed voices (the key is the voice id)

offset.description: semitones from harmony.root (octave 4); ignored if instrument.pitched=false

cents_offset.description: fine detune in cents (beating/chorus). Dropped in plain-MIDI translation (ADR 0026) — a future MPE mode restores it as pitch bend

prob.description: chance this voice fires; rolled deterministically per loop_id+frame+index

velocity.description: MIDI Note-On velocity (ADR 0026), native units. Only consumed when the voice lands on a type "midi" instrument; absent ⇒ that instrument's velocity_default (⇒ 100)

t.description: sub-step onset within the host step, in steps (ADR 0028): 0.5 = the "and", 1/3 = second triplet. 0 = on the beat; 1.0 belongs to the next step

phraseRef.description: the phrase arm (ADR 0028) — the third exclusive note-source shape (steps ⊕ generator ⊕ phrase); requires an explicit step_duration

pool.description: sequence_pools ids and/or built-in lib:<name> entries this modulator draws from; unknown ids are a hard error

active.description: pin one pool entry (the Orrery rewrites this per phrase window); absent ⇒ `select` picks per tile

select.description: per-tile selection when `active` is absent — seeded by the tile ordinal, not loop_id (a seam-straddling tile decides identically on both sides)

tags.description: restrict selection to entries carrying ALL of these tags

realized.description: machine-written (Orrery) refit copy of the active entry — wins over `active`; hand-authoring it lints

phraseDef.description: an authored sequence_pools entry (ADR 0028): at least one note; every gate must satisfy t + dur ≤ length (the engine validates)

phraseRealized.description: the Orrery's machine-written refit copy — may have NO notes: a narrative drop materializes an empty tile as legal silence

phraseDefBase.description: shape shared by an authored sequence_pools entry and the Orrery's `realized` copy: pitch + rhythm + articulation, tiled every `length` HOST steps

fit.description: Harmony tracking: chord = re-voiced via melody-fit under the Orrery, snapped to the authored harmony.mode scale under a plain render; arp = like chord, but every note to a chord tone along the written line (ties follow its direction, no re-strike where it moves (a 9th/11th/13th tension when no new chord tone fits), inside the modulator's orrery_note_min/max if set, else its written range; never developed); root = parallel transpose (verbatim without a chord); literal = always as written.

tags.description: free-form selection tags (busy/calm/sparse/lift/…) the selector and Orrery energy gate filter by

notes.description: ascending by t (lint-warned otherwise; evaluation sorts)

phraseNote.description: one phrase note; owns the deterministic voice id p{k} (k = legato-chain head index) — `dur` present = gated + re-strikes per tile, absent = HOLDS across tiles (sustain/glide, the pad idiom)

t.description: onset in host steps from the tile start (0 ≤ t < length; fractional = sub-step, thirds give triplets)

dur.description: gate length in host steps (dur > 0 and t + dur ≤ length — a gate ends inside its own tile): paired note-off at t + dur

legato.description: reuse the previous note's voice → the engine glides (slur) instead of re-striking; lints on a phrase's first note

prob.description: chance this note fires; a failed roll skips the strike AND its note-off (rolled per tile ordinal, loop_id-free)

velocity.description: MIDI Note-On velocity (ADR 0026); only consumed on a type "midi" instrument

cents_offset.description: fine detune in cents; dropped in plain-MIDI translation

pool.description: semitone offsets the generator cycles through

matrixEntry.description: Routes a modulator to a destination. NOTHING sounds until wired here. A mod route's depth is written in its dest's unit, under exactly one key: depth_oct, depth_st, depth_cents, depth_s, depth_ms, depth_db, depth_hz, depth_x, or plain depth into a 0..1 dest (ADR 0054 P4).

dest.description: JSONPath: instruments.<inst>.params.<param> | instruments.<inst>.notes | global.<param> | buses.<bus>.return_gain_db | buses.<bus>.effects.<fx>.params.<param>

depth.description: mod: into a 0..1 dest (`resonance`, a mix, `stereo_width`, a midi param): a signed fraction of it, added to the base (then clamped)

depth_oct.description: mod: into a log-frequency or log-time dest (`cutoff_hz`, `band_*_hz`, `t60_s`, `ring_ratio`): octaves at the source's ±1 (6.64 oct spans a cutoff)

depth_s.description: mod: into an envelope time (`attack_s`, `decay_s`, `release_s`): seconds

depth_db.description: mod: into a gain (`level_db`, the osc levels, `master_gain_db`, `return_gain_db`) or `drive_db`: dB, summed in dB (a route into a -Infinity base is inaudible)

depth_hz.description: mod: into a linear-Hz dest (the binaural `root_hz`, `spread_hz`): Hz

depth_slew_ms.description: mod: smooths depth changes across loops

voices.description: note: voice budget into the instrument's polyphony

priority.description: note: lower = kept, higher = stolen first when sources share an instrument

matrixEntryPatch.description: A partial matrixEntry (song layers, ADR 0029): any subset of the fields. A route id not in the base matrix must give source + dest + kind.

matrix.description: a song.matrices layer name; absent = the top-level matrix as-is

loops.description: how many inner loops this block lasts

seed.description: explicit block seed (mixed with the session seed): blocks sharing one replay the same Orrery voyage. Keep it small (JSON numbers > 2^53 lose precision).

label.description: display label (defaults to the layer name)

control.description: this block's session control (ADR 0055): a patch over the session's (the doc's control + CLI flags, an --objectives file, or a live edit), for this block only — the next block starts from the session's again

blockControl.description: A song block's control (ADR 0055), in the doc's own control vocabulary. Applied over the session control at the block's start; a live edit mid-block wins for the fields it changes until the next block.

optimize.description: the timbre axis for this block: hold freezes the authored values, drift walks them

movement.description: a partial movement merged over the session's field by field: `orrery: false` turns the Orrery off for the block (the bound voices play their authored material); other fields retune it. A later block with the Orrery on starts a fresh voyage from home.

max_drift.description: the block's cumulative drift cap (normalized), in place of the doc's max_drift

max_change.description: caps the block's per-loop step (normalized); the session's step (--max-change, else the doc's) stays the ceiling

drift.description: per-param drift overrides keyed by canonical JSONPath (a drift candidate, as `constraints` keys are): "hold" pins it at its authored value; {min, max} gives it its own band in NATIVE units; {max_drift} its own cap (normalized) around the authored value. Replaces a session `constraints` band on the same key.

blockDriftOverride.description: A block drift override: a native {min, max} band (either end optional), or a normalized max_drift around the authored value — not both.

constraintBand.description: A [min,max] bound in native units; either end optional (a gain's min may be -Infinity). Shared by safe_bounds (Tier-2) and constraints (Tier-3, in the doc or an objectives doc).

movement.description: Musical-movement axis (mirrors objectives_v0.1 `movement`; Rust: contract::Movement). `tension_max` / `voice_changes_per_loop` / `home` are parsed but inert.

bind.description: which note modulators the Orrery drives (by id)

phrase_loops.description: loops per phrase (how often a chord change can happen)

arrange.description: optional Arranger tuning; every field defaults to the built-in constant (absent ⇒ byte-identical)

arp_density.description: arp euclid-density band as a FRACTION of the arp's authored length (default 0.12..0.70)

return_hazard_scale.description: multiplier on every return-home hazard; >1 returns home sooner, <1 wanders longer
